records.name: Standing-static short acceleration, retained technical context
records.mechanics: Comfortable bilateral standing-static start, natural arms, individual release through 5 m target; continue the entire 15 m gradual runoff, then use the separate inspected outside walking return. No staggered two-point start, hard target stop, cut, race or timed test.
records.readinessAndBoundary: Source output profile is provenance, not the exact lower-intent instructional prescription. Require prior actual repeatable same start/5+15 m route/intent/return and current suitability. E0 is the first counted opportunity, E1 only remaining opportunities after suitable E0. technical_low_20 preserves actual 50–60% and at most two starts even in D. A shorter or easier record cannot restore this route.
records.sourceDefaultBoundary: 85–100% intent, 5–20 m target and 10–30 m runoff, 120–240 s rest are local source Output defaults; OR10 uses its explicit retained teaching context, no high-speed pass.

records.name: Standing-static short acceleration, retained easy context
records.mechanics: Same standing-static movement; 5 m target plus 10 m gradual runoff at retained easy 2 to 3/10, followed by its outside walking return.
records.readinessAndBoundary: D only. Require actual repeatable same 5+10 m easy route and current fit. No first running instruction, no long 35 m run credit, no substitute proof of the 5+15 m technical route. Lower intent and shorter runoff are declared dose/logistics context, not a new exercise identity or exact source Output profile.

records.name: Ordinary walking route orientation
records.mechanics: Ordinary forward walking through the declared target and walking exit, then a separate one-way walking return; no terminal braking stick, forced pace or running action. P2 explicitly selects 10 m or 15 m outbound; main walking is 5+5 m.
records.readinessAndBoundary: Actual comfortable walking, turning and route conduct plus verified paths; walking may be taught within its counted opportunity without a prior running pass. Short P2 does not establish complete 20 m running/runoff readiness.
records.identityBoundary: Existing authored ordinary-walk context; no source155 deceleration profile or invented canonical identity.

records.name: Bilateral ready-position or quiet-standing context
records.mechanics: P1: remain in personal bay, settle 2 s and hold comfortable bilateral ready stance 3 s, relaxed/ready arms, feet still, no launch. Stationary P2/main: 2 s settle, 2 s comfortable quiet bilateral hold with knees unlocked and arms relaxed, 6 s reset; no travel.
records.readinessAndBoundary: Independently comfortable standing and basic conduct suffice. These two explicit hold doses are not running, braking, squatting or split-stance passes. Later gather/staging is separately timed, not hidden in P1.

records.name: Tempo Bodyweight Squat
records.mechanics: Unloaded comfortable bilateral stance and owned free-squat range, level heels; 3 s lower, 1 s gentle pause, 1 s stand. No box contact, manual support or new depth target.
records.readinessAndBoundary: Existing SQUAT-BW identity with an explicit 3-1-1 OR10 delivery context. Familiar actual control/count governs. Unknown longitudinal dose may use at most two counted reps only when independently suitable; smaller actual one-rep ceiling persists. This is not automatic loaded permission.
records.sourceDefaultBoundary: Legacy source supplies a controlled slow descent and brief pause; exact 3-1-1 cadence, one set and reduced counts are declared session dosage.

records.name: Goblet Squat — Dumbbell, level heels
records.mechanics: ONE dumbbell, two-hand center-chest support, controlled pickup, declared bilateral stance, level heels, owned range, controlled dynamic squat and set-down. OR10 fitting context: fixed nonadjustable DB held shaft vertical, both palms under opposite sides of upper head with comfortable fingers around edges, lower head clear of trunk; stable individually fitting elevated cradle supports lower head only during parking. The cradle carries no load during squat reps. Preserve 3 s lower / 1 s gentle pause / 1 s stand; breathe naturally.
records.readinessAndBoundary: Source prerequisites are pain-free owned bodyweight squat, ability to pick up and hold selected object, and stop signal. For first loading, actual selected-object pickup/support is observed in the counted handling before any loaded rep; prior complete loaded squat is not required. Known bodyweight squat or two-DB hinge is not selected-grip evidence. All five knee contracts remain distinct; failure consumes set and coach handles parking, no replacement/test set. Exact grip/parking height are authored fit choices, not universal source constants.
records.selectionTradeoff: Selected dynamic one-DB goblet preserves bilateral owned squat with one centered implement. Kettlebell horns/bell, medicine-ball chest support and heel elevation have exact distinct variants; barbell, two independent racks, unilateral rack and sumo are not silent substitutes.
records.sourceQuarantine: Migration retains review status and human/publication/media/calibration gates unresolved. Runtime-selected definition UUIDs and authored local scores are not current live IDs or calibration.

records.name: Bodyweight Hip Hinge Good Morning
records.mechanics: Arms crossed at chest, soft knees; hips back 3 s and stand 1 s through actual owned comfortable range. Five seconds setup/exit. No wall contact, floor reach or new arm position.
records.readinessAndBoundary: Actual currently familiar pattern/setup/control; unknown longitudinal count may use its at-most-two packet, not first unfamiliar instruction. Most recent actual unloaded record blocks calling older DB work retained.

records.name: Romanian Deadlift — two dumbbells, standard tempo
records.mechanics: TWO dumbbells, one per hand, palms inward and long arms, tall top start near thighs; soft knees, organized trunk, close weight paths and owned hamstring-limited range, no floor-touch quota. Retained elevated parking: 4 s pickup, 3 s lower/1 s stand repetitions, 4 s set-down and 2 s clear.
records.readinessAndBoundary: D only, actual most recent compatible same pair/load/range/count and independently familiar pickup/top-start/hinge/set-down. One first OR06 loaded set does not establish familiar 10 s handling. No first loaded hip instruction or restoration after newer unloading. Five fitting elevated stations/ten suitable DBs and two-coach direct observation must fit.
records.sourceDefaultBoundary: Local capacity-strength source 2–5 sets, 3–10 reps, 90–240 s recovery is not OR10 one-set retained teaching dosage; neutral hand orientation and elevated parking are exact authored setup context.

records.name: Push-Up — hands elevated on stable support
records.mechanics: Hands secure on individually fitted stable elevated platform, feet on lower support at recorded position, organized head/pelvis/feet body line; owned full cycle 2 s lower/1 s press, no knees-down or new support geometry.
records.readinessAndBoundary: Familiar actual support and control only. Verify current contacts in setup; first listed rep observes response. No first support-height/push instruction in the short role, no automatic lower support by age. Migration455 is a later exact local family contract than the frozen legacy incline-push-up snapshot; 682 normalizes profile attributes without granting approval.
records.sourceDefaultBoundary: Source capacity-strength 3 x 8 and 120 s rest/reserve2 are not copied; OR10 retained one small set, 60 s recovery and >=5 RIR are an explicit teaching dose.

records.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row — bench supported
records.mechanics: OPPOSITE hand AND knee on suitable stable bench, other foot planted; one actual familiar DB, pull toward hip/lower rib without intentional torso rotation, 1 s pull/1 s organized top/2 s lower. One set includes both sides, 10 s side change and 10 s total handling.
records.readinessAndBoundary: Familiar actual bench contacts, selected DB grip/handling and both-side control. Source orientation/light first reps are counted listed work, never bonus reps. Independent suspension substitute requires its own familiar anchors/angle/body line; no manual assistance or new loaded row lesson.
records.sourceDefaultBoundary: Source 4 x 6 per side/120 s recovery/reserve2 and source transition estimates are defaults, not the one-set OR10 dose or its 10 s side change.

records.name: Ring Row / TRX Row, bilateral suspension alternative
records.mechanics: Two equal stable suspension contacts, secure grips, independently familiar body angle and foot position; organized whole-body line and bilateral pulling/lowering. Exact anchors, handles and range must be recorded.
records.readinessAndBoundary: Legacy local candidate, no verified exact current canonical profile. Requires independent familiar suspension setup/control and fitting anchors. It is a bilateral alternative, not the same unilateral bench-supported variant or automatic equipment equivalence.

records.name: Dead Bug Heel Tap — arms fixed, alternating bent-leg heel contact
records.mechanics: Supine, arms fixed vertically, comfortable tabletop; lower one bent leg to light heel contact at selected target, return then alternate, 2 s out/2 s back. No heel slide, long straight-leg lever or opposite-arm reach.
records.readinessAndBoundary: Actual comfortable floor access/tabletop and trunk/limb control; setup checks retained position, first counted heel contact observes response. If unavailable, separately eligible fully supported breathing or defer. Source Prepare profile is exact provenance; use in retained Strength brace role is disclosed contextual placement, not canonical profile approval.
records.sourceDefaultBoundary: Local contract 1–3 sets, 3–6 cycles per side, 20–45 s rest and setup20/perSet40/reset20 are not OR10 retained low-dose defaults.

records.name: 90/90 Breathing with Reach — lower legs supported, bilateral reach
records.mechanics: Supine lower legs/calves and/or heels fully passively supported by stable nonrolling bench/box near 90/90. BOTH arms reach vertically together with gentle scapular protraction; comfortable inhale and longer unforced exhale. No heel drive, hip lift, forced flattening/crunch, breath hold or sequential side reach.
records.readinessAndBoundary: Independent comfortable floor access, fitted full passive support, comfortable bilateral reach and breathing. Current OR10 selects four comfortable 5 s cycles (2 in/3 out) plus 20 s handling and 15 s recovery; source approximately 4–6 s exhale only if comfortable is a source default, not compulsory. Prepare/access profile placement as a simple retained brace alternative is explicit.
records.sourceDefaultBoundary: Source one set/four breaths/15 s rest; the OR10 shorter unforced 2/3 cadence is an explicit delivery context. Both arms together is the selected source action.

bodyweight.loadSelectionContract: Retain actual bodyweight control/count or deliberately unload under current response. If suitable control history is unknown, use the explicit one-set, at-most-2-rep observation; the first listed rep is counted. A smaller recent 1-rep ceiling still governs. Missing suitability means defer, not automatic entry.
bodyweight.unknownSuitableObservationBoundary: Current suitability is independent; preserve an actual smaller one-rep ceiling. First listed rep is counted, not an added screen.

goblet_first.loadSelectionContract: First external knee loading: actual repeatable same-range/stance/3-1-1 bodyweight squat and suitable current response are required. Choose one light individually manageable DB from verified stock before the set; record kg and why its grip/size/load fit. Observe exact grip, pickup and 3 s chest support in counted handling before any loaded rep. No prior whole loaded squat is required. If no credible fitting load is available, choose eligible bodyweight before pickup or defer.

goblet_retained.loadSelectionContract: Retain the most recent actual compatible repeatable one-DB goblet record: exact DB/grip/kg, range, stance, tempo and smaller repetitions. Familiar controlled 10 s handling must be established. An older loaded record followed by a newer unloaded knee record is not this route.

goblet_load_step.loadSelectionContract: With the most recent actual repeatable compatible goblet set, suitable current response and at least 5 good reps in reserve, consider one smallest available increment only if the coach reasonably expects the same reserve/control. Record actual old/new kg and increment; hold the old load when the available step is too large. Use full renewed 20 s handling and the same actual repetition ceiling. No automatic weekly increment or multiple trial weights.

goblet_reintroduce.loadSelectionContract: An older compatible goblet record plus a newer unloaded bilateral squat exposure permits consideration, not restoration. This is explicitly a resistance progression from the recent bodyweight baseline. Require current repeatable same-pattern bodyweight control, suitable response and a stated reason the earlier unloading need no longer governs. Choose an individually fitting older or lower DB load, renew exact counted 20 s handling and preserve the recent bodyweight repetition ceiling. Older loaded competence alone does not bypass current suitability; a different static supported stance is not a bilateral squat unloading record.
goblet_reintroduce.priorLoadedHistoryBoundary: An older compatible record is evidence for considering reintroduction, not current retention or current suitability.
